138.synopsis:
Xiang Ye (Ah Ye) and Charles have the fated arrangement of master and servant. In the depths of darkness, Ah Ye scooped up Charles – a vampire butler. Possessing a fervid passion for service, Charles single-mindedly attends to the secretive young master Ah Ye – regardless of his ferocious appetite, abhorrent taste in clothing, and relationship failings – for the master is always right.
On the other hand, in the chaotic era of scientifically enhanced humans, powerful heroes become the protectors of normal citizens, going where evil needs subduing. This young master may be secretive, but he is our hero.

394.synopsis: The MC (Minato) is a college student who died in a plane crash and was reincarnated in a fantasy world. He was raised alone in the wilderness by his succubus mother, and now he tries to make his way as an adventurer.

1930.synopsis:
The story revolves around Charles Karino, a Levaamu Empire mercenary aerial pilot who mans the twin seater reconnaissance seaplane Santa Cruz. One day, he receives a preposterous assignment: to fly solo over 12,000 kilometers of enemy waters to protect a girl named Fana del Moral. Fana happens to be the next in line to the empire’s throne and a girl possessing beauty “equal to 5,000 beams of light.” 
This is a standalone book, but there are 17 total books in this universe (飛空士).
Adapted to anime as “The Princess and the Pilot”
associated_names: A Certain Recollection of a Pilot
とある飛空士への追憶

2954.synopsis:
Jude caught a serial killer who puts New York in a big panic. The name is Alvin Jones. Alvin is outwardly normal like any office worker. His demeanour and attitude make people highly unlikely to associate him with serial killings. However, his crime was discovered and he was caught. 
For some reason, he finds that Detective Jude is an interesting person. Hence, he only talks when being interrogated by Detective Jude inside the interrogation room. This leaves all the crime profilers and psychologists in a quandary as he refuses to cooperate with them. Unsurprisingly, Alvin later escapes leaving a letter for Detective Jude. After his escape, his letters consistently reached Jude, and he seems to always help Jude whenever Jude is in trouble. Is there more to it than what it is on the surface?

3978.synopsis:
Legend has it that two experts left a half-finished chess game on the hilltop of eastern dynasty’s number one mountain called “King Mountain”. A few sentences are left on the board at a time when the eastern dynasty is experiencing turmoil, chaos and instability.
A woman dressed in a simple white robe like the snowy moon, praised as having “unsurpassable grace,” also happens to be one who acts and speaks freely, wild like the wind, such a person is praised and respected by the rest of the martial arts world (wulin). How is she to be “Carefree as the Wind” in such a wrecked and chaotic time?
A man who is completely opposite, dressed by the dark moon. He is graceful and honorable, kind and tolerant. This kind of person that the rest of the martial arts world (wulin) admires and submits to. In such a chaotic time where morals are loose, what kind of benignity can he accomplish?
A prince, born into exaltedness. His martial arts (wugong) is matchless, he is proud and strong, ambitious, and said to have the “arrogance of a King”. In this ever chaotic world, how will he accomplish his dominancy?
A noble princess who is beautiful and glamorous. With an ambitious and calculating heart, how she manoeuvres her way to reign supreme in the dangerous palace harem?
A world well-known intelligent princess who is good at martial arts. How in the face of national crisis, she guards her country and people in this troubled times?
A reclusive and mysterious prince who is well loved by his people. In such troubled times, will he live in seclusion or step out?
Home and country, how to counterbalance?
Love and hate, how to define clearly?
Gratitude and revenge, how to repay?
Beauty and world, which is more important?
In this troubled times, there are many talented men. The chess game on the hilltop is between two people but to rule supreme in the world, only one person is needed!

4234.synopsis: A collection of side stories set in the AntiMagic Academy “The 35th Test Platoon” universe.

My past life: Ordinary. Mediocre.

8074.synopsis:
If a man is honest, courageous, exceptional, not only can capture attention but also cook, lives across from you, of course you should push him down. 
If a woman is kindhearted, sharp, smart, quick-witted, not only protective but can also solve cases, lives across from you, of course you should eat her.

They were neighbors for four years, she never thought that one day he would become her man. A lawyer and a policeman, two busy occupations, originally deemed impossible to be together, however due to one case, it started their life of “possibilities.”
One is a foodie and one is a chef, one talkative one quiet. One caring and one cold.

8586.synopsis:
Luo Wei and Xiao Ying parted ways after a brief encounter in their childhood, but Xiao Ying has stayed in Luo Wei’s heart as a lasting memory.
When they meet again, Luo Wei is a budding jewelry designer, but he Xiao Ying had already become He Ying Ze, someone who stood high above the crowds. Luo Wei found herself perplexed as she roamed, slowly grasping her deep-rooted emotions, yet ultimately choosing to slowly detach herself from the distant and unattainable He Ying Ze. However, Luo Wei cannot prevent herself from being hurt by the deliberate display of aloofness and coldness from He Ying Ze, even though she tries to convince herself not to be affected by it.
As Luo Wei is ready to sever all ties with He Ying Ze, an unexpected incident causes He Ying Ze to tightly hold onto Luo Wei’s hand.

The whole universe turned into a fantastic new world where everyone could rise to the top through cultivation. 20618.synopsis:
Kawamura Hideo, a typical ordinary guy with no job, came to Tokyo searching for jobs. He sent a total of 34 job applications only to fail at the first hurdle (the companies didn’t even ask him for an interview). Feeling rejected he became a hardcore hikikomori and shut the world around him, his parents also won’t send him money since then. When he was starving to death without any money, losing hope and deciding to die, he found a computer on the street (containing Will.CO21 virus) and took it home.
He found a way to participate in a martial arts tournament “Holy Devil Cup” from that computer. Where the winner could get the power to rule the world, martial artists, soldiers, vampires, Majin – all 3024 participants gather there. Now what Hideo would do to win this mad tournament. . .

23690.synopsis:
Luo Qing Chen is a wandering spirit that died thirty thousand years ago, roaming the Chaos Space
In order to not turn into dust, she is bound by an ice cold system to travel through time and space to complete missions.

25482.synopsis: Liu Yu Sheng hails from a rich family. After studying abroad, he returns home to find his inheritance stolen by his other family members. To make a living, he has to work as a teacher at a small school. In this hopeless state, he meets a dear, old friend in Zhou Yao Hua. Who, like the majority of China harbors a hatred against communists. However, Liu Yu Sheng has connections with communists. Could he betray his friend? Thus begins Yu Sheng’s rounds of difficult choices.

25738.synopsis:
Yin Li was born with a pure Yin body. He possessed the body of a male but the fate of a female, his Yin and Yan energies fully inverted. Because of this, his family’s old ancestors claimed he wouldn’t be able to live past twenty years of age.
To prolong his life, his parents fostered a furnace whose energy he could harvest to nurture his own.
As Yin Li looked at the frail and delicately charming boy in front of him, he felt his heart stir with compassion.
The Heavenly Path is carried through reincarnation, life and death are decided by fate.
He couldn’t simply ruin this pitiful child for the sake of his own selfish interests. Instead, he kept the small boy at his side, spoiling him and raising him as his trusted aide.
He truly believed they shared a master and servant’s pure and honest affection, not at all realizing that that wicked boy had been rotten from the start. The delicately charming small boy who was spoiled day and night only ever thought about two things:
1. Why hasn’t master bestowed his favour on me yet?
2. Just how can I climb into master’s bed?

26506.synopsis:
After one night sleeping with him, she found he was her father’s sworn brother.
She tried to hide herself from him and meant to bury these filthy pasts deep in her heart, but ultimately failed to escape from the beautiful memories.
She loved him so much and so blindly that troubles found their way to her.
He disappeared, loved and married another woman. This regretless love fraud tortured her, so much so that he finally turned into the sharpest thorn in her heart.
She had love, and pain, but lost.
As long as she closed her eyes, the very tender look that he had when doting on her to the utmost came to her mind…

27786.synopsis:
She roused from a pool of blood, vowing to exact retribution on those who had harmed her.
She slapped her despicable father and smacked his wicked concubines
She trampled on a two-faced girl who acted innocent but had a malicious heart, and pointed her sword towards the heartless man who was unworthy of her love.
Countless beasts trembled in front of her cute pet, and her divine artifact intimidated even the Ninth Heaven.
As soon as her Elixir Furnace was lit up, the world came to kneel before her.
Between him and her, it all started with a fair trade. Yet, the handsome demon ended up being obsessed with her.
“Lay an egg for me, and I’ll promise you a peaceful life in any of the three realms!” He wrapped himself around her eagerly.
“Leave me alone, and I’ll grant you a long life till eternity!” She pushed him away with a defiant laugh.
associated_names: The Unparalleled Spiritual Doctor: Demon Emperor's Defiant Love

31114.synopsis:
If time gives you another chance to meet your lover ahead of time…….
Shi Jian (Shi can be translated as Time in English) and her husband Ye Jia Cheng were originally a happily married loving couple, making people green with envy. But the two still cannot live to an old age in marital bliss. Unexpectedly, Shi Jian was transported back to when she was 21 years old.
Twenty-one years old is the beginning of youth, the best time of your life. Time let her meet the twenty-five years old Ye Jia Cheng, ahead of time.
At this time her “Mr. Ye” was still handsome and talented. Unfortunately, he did not love her.
“Ye Jia Cheng … I’m really your future wife … really.”
“Impossible, little fox, I am in the Don’t Want to Get Married Group.

37514.synopsis:
If life were likened to god rolling the dice, then Lu YunFei is a 6. He’s handsome and smart, save for his abysmal proficiency in English. That is until he met Bian JinYuan — Bian JinYuan is tall and cool, top of his grade in every exam, and his English results definitely destroy Lu YunFei’s twice over. If he’s a 6, then this guy is simply 666!
Since YunFei is already here, why would there be a need for JinYuan? It’s hard for a mountain to accommodate two tigers, unless one is a male while the other is female. Lu YunFei looked at the other party’s gender, and silently crossed that thought out.
However, not long after he started to treat Bian JinYuan as a rival, he found that after 9pm, he would mysteriously possess Bian JinYuan’s Tmall Genie. (A cat mascot similar to Amazon Alexa or Google Home.)
After possessing the Tmall Genie, Lu YunFei realised that his rival is actually a pauper prince. Lu YunFei who possessed looks, height, and wealth looked at his cards which were almost overflowing with money, and decided to establish his friendship relations. Therefore, since Bian JinYuan lacked money, Lu YunFei hired him to be his English tutor.
Bian JinYuan bought a cake and couldn’t bear to eat it so that he could bring it home for his family. Lu YunFei bought him a large slice of cake the next day.
Having done good deeds everyday, Lu YunFei felt that the invisible red scarf on his chest had gotten brighter.
Until there was a hot post on the school forum: 《Expose on Lu YunFei – getting the top student to be your lackey, do you really think that it’s all that to have money! 》
The original poster listed down various instances: bag-carrying, bringing water, peeling chestnuts; the school genius was ordered about as if he were a servant. Everyone was enjoying the gossip, when Bian JinYuan who had never posted in the forum before, posted for the first time with his real name.
Bian JinYuan: I don’t need the money, I’m willing, why do you care?
Everyone was scared dumb.
Lu YunFei worried about whether he should bother Bian JinYuan less.
“That’s not necessary, I like being bothered by you.”
“Forget it,” Lu YunFei rejected.
Bian JinYuan thought for a bit: “Then let me rephrase — that’s not necessary, I like you.”
Lu YunFei: ???!!!
Lu YunFei never expected that the mountain is wide and holds many types of tigers. Together, two male tigers can not only run fast, but also fall in love!
associated_names: 穿进校草的天猫精灵后

40074.synopsis:
I became the daughter of the heroine in a completed novel.
The original story was over, and I was living a happy life thanks to the buffs of having the heroine as a mother.
“Velsia. Only I will ever love everything about you.”
The son of a villainess who suffered from madness.
Emil Calixt, an innocent boy isolated due to the villainess’ sins.
Inheriting her madness, that boy slaughtered my family,
and upon my death, I returned to the age of ten.
So, in an attempt to avoid death
I tried to cure Emil’s madness…
“You are the only one who saw me for who I am.”
“…Emil, hold on just a moment.”
“You are the only one who reached out to me.”
However, that boy, whom I thought had grown better than anyone else…
“So, you are the only one who must remain by my side.”
Contrary to my intentions, he became obsessed with me.
“I… want you to keep pitying me.”
That little boy had grown into a man, and now he was clinging onto me.
associated_names: The Son of a Wicked Woman Is Innocent

42122.synopsis:
“ Your curse, I’ll solve it. In exchange, please accept me as a bloody traction.”
From the information of the original story she learns the reason of her mother’s death. Lobelia realizes her own situation, deprived from her everything and driven her into becoming a villain, decides to take revenge.
She escapes out of the hands of an uncle who wants to control and tries to get back her share. 
She went to Duke Ferrado, who is known to be dangerous, and made her suggestion
 “I know a better way. I’ve been thinking about a contract relationship. How’s it?”
The man comes up with an unexpected reverse proposal. Lobelia shakes off the money line of her uncle with his support. 
In front of her, the heroine of the original story and the daughter of the enemy appears as her rival.
 “Sister, why in the world did you change like this?”
Will Lobelia be able to complete her revenge? 
She said, “When it’s all over, I still want to be with you.” 
And can she have a happy ending with the man she woos?

42634.synopsis:
“I’m pregnant with another man’s child.”
A lie she was forced to tell to reject a proposal from the most vicious mercenary leader on the entire continent. 
However, his answer…
“It doesn’t matter whose child you’re carrying; you can give birth to him. But in return, I will own you, Princess.”
She couldn’t grasp the meaning of his words. What did this man really want from a princess of a poor kingdom on the verge of ruin?

43146.synopsis:
Ethan let Ruelli become another man’s woman, just for the sake of her happiness.
But contrary to what Ethan had willed, Ruelli’s fiancé cruelly pierced her heart, betraying her. 
Highly grieving, she loses her memories and assumes Ethan to be her fiancé. 
“I feel like I’ve lived my whole life for nothing.”
After someone attempts to mu*der Ruelli, she comes know that something was wrong. 
Ethan is dead set to save her, who had been from being abandoned by both her parents and god,  to give her everything he can.
“Take my hand and run away with me. From your cursed destiny.”

44426.synopsis:
“Louis, trust me. Let’s escape together.”
“Yes, Juliana.”
Betrayed by her trusted fiance and a close friend. Louis, who spent the night with her, clenched her hand with an unreadable expression on his face.
“Louis, I’ll take responsibility!”
She thought she’d protect this fragile man… but what’s this?
Turns out he was the Empire’s lunatic!!
* * *
“Do you expect me to stay still when other men are drooling over what’s mine?” Louis looked straight at her and smiled beautifully, “Sweet, even your tears are so sweet… I’m not going crazy, am I?”
His low-pitched voice and intense gaze bound her with an unbroken possessive desire.
Can she get away from this crazy man?

44682.synopsis:
Noein Arkvist (protagonist) has a twisted personality. Born as a son of a great aristocrat’s concubine, he was always made aware of that fact as he grew up. Also, after he grew up he was forced into a remote territory, a bottom rank and was cut off from his parents’ home.
“I don’t want to be a sneaky and empty person like my f*cking parents.”
“I want to live a happy life surrounded by a lot of love.”
That is why Noein decided, to become an ideal lord, an aristocrat that everyone praises. To do that let’s shower people with love and benevolence so as to be loved by them. Let’s make friendships with your neighbors, aim for coexistence and co-prosperity, and use them for your own well-being.
This is a story about a young man with a slightly distorted temperament who try’s to live to have a happy life in his own way.

46218.synopsis:
After twenty seven sad premature deaths, Ayin walked across Naihe Bridge to seek justice from the ghost monarch. Xiuyan told her that there were only two possibilities for such bad luck: one was that she had offended a great figure in the gods, and the other was that she herself was a great figure.
Ayin scoffed at this, since the True God Bai Jue died and the ancient world was closed, there were no great figures in the Three Realms.
Only after a long time that Ayin realized that Xiuyan’s answer was correct.
It’s a pity that in the Three Realms there is no place for Ayin.
When she jumped into Wangchuan for the last time, she finally figured out one thing, that the demon, god and devil didn’t live long on the Three Realms.
Demons, gods and devils, born in the world, will always be annihilated, such as her.

46474.synopsis:

47242.synopsis:
Qin Fang was one of the most handsome guys in C National University. His visuals were impeccable, but, the problem was, he was a great troublemaker, and knew how to fight. 
Xing Yan was a stellar student in the Chemistry Institute, but his temperament was cold and introverted, and he communicated little with others. The first time he met Qin Fang, the two forcefully rammed their shoulders into each other. When their four eyes met, both knew that the other was not any good person. 
Qin Fang jokingly flirted with Xing Yan, saying, “I’m Qin Fang, sophomore in Global Commerce. You can come find me any time, your Fang Ge will wait for you.”
Later, on a quiet evening, Xing Yan was smoking on the balcony. Qin Fang used his legs as a pillow, his expression containing a little embarrassed smile as he pointed to the evening sky and said, “Actually, Qin Fang was a name I changed myself, my original name was… Jian Xingxing*.”
From then on, I was not afraid of even the darkest nights, since I could just raise my head to see stars. 
*T/n: The novel name, in chinese pinyin, is Jian Xing Xing (捡星星) while the mentioned original name of the character is Jian Xingxing (简星星). However, the “捡(jian)” in the title means to pick up, while this 简 (jian) is a surname. The same two characters that follow are xing (星), meaning star.

47754.synopsis:
I’m Mitsuhiko Okaya, 29 years old.
I’m an editor at a publishing company.
The day I witnessed my wife cheating on me, twin JKs suddenly came to my house.
“Uncle, if you let me stay tonight, you can do …… naughty things ♡”
“That …… please …… you’re the only person I can rely on …….”
Akari, a blonde gal, and Nanako, a neat, black-haired girl, a pair of high school girls I’ve never met, but they look vaguely familiar.
After my wife cheated on me, I moved to a new publishing company and started a strange life together with these two high school girls.
Akari, the younger sister, who aggressively seduces me, and Nanako, the older sister, who is reserved but actually very naughty.
The two of them heal me, and together we heal my wounded heart. ……
One day, my ex-wife apologizes to me. In addition, the person she cheated on me with and my old boss came to me on their knees.
She said that she realized that I was actually competent at my previous publishing company and came to apologize.
But it was too late. I’m enjoying my new life with the beautiful JKs and my white workplace.

Yehe died and a “golden system” bound him to help him live again.

49802.synopsis:
The sky continent of Camamita and the four specialities of the human state of the Roschodur Empire.
The Nettle bread that you couldn’t forget the taste, once you eat it.
Rosetta, the Sage of the East Forest.
Prince Inborgia, the 400-year-old High Elf who has been naturalized in the human Empire.
And, the dark flame mage, the Great Sage, Duke Katlena Agreta.
The cold and ruthless life of this woman, who doesn’t know the heart of a person, was dotted with modifiers such as ‘youngest’, ‘iron-blooded’,or ‘scary’.
So, when she personally recommended to the Emperor to let Prince Inborgia return to the capital, the one who had ruined her family, the world naturally thought of this:
‘Ah! At last, Duke Agreta will cut Prince Inborgia’s head!’
When she dared to summon the family’s head to the capital where her secret assassination group took control. How thorough the revenge of this ruthless Duke was designed.
But at the first encounter in fifteen years, Katlena Agreta said to him:
“Contrary to the hasty thoughts of the world, I have no intention of retaliating against you, Your Excellency. But you wouldn’t be naive to say that I’ve forgiven you, right? You’re a smart person after all.”
Ending the conversation halfheartedly, Katlena Agreta pulled her chin out curiously. Looking down at Schaurillin Inborgia with a gaze that seemed to contain contempt for a person.
“I have decided not to take revenge on you. Please consider the true meaning of these words…” 
‘Yes, I decided not to take revenge.’
Because she knew it would be the wisest way.

50314.synopsis: When Su Qingxu successfully returned to the rich, her family became a mess because of the fake daughter fell in love with her brother. Ravian, who had been looking down at the petite girl as if she were a mouse, suddenly realized that he was at a loss for words in front of a woman for the first time.
He cast an incredulous look at his subordinates.
“What is this…?”
“She’s the niece of the one who told you to kidnap her. So, Boss, you take care of her.”
An extraordinary hostage situation and childcare – the unprecedented maximum-value project of the kidnappers.

73610.synopsis: In this world, there are heroes and magical girls who make contracts with spirits to defeat creatures called Phantoms, which feed off negative human energy. The protagonist, Kisaragi Kurona, is one such individual who fights Phantoms. However, the power he possesses doesn’t manifest as a hero, something most boys would admire. So, what does it manifest as? Shockingly, Kurona transforms into a magical girl, which is the complete opposite of both his gender and the typical dreams of young boys. The sole reason Kurona chose to be a magical girl is simple: his sister loved magical girls.
associated_names: For My Little Sister, I Became a Magical Girl
I Became a Magical Girl for My Sister
妹のために魔法少女になりました

74122.synopsis:
An ordinary (?) protagonist, Jin Maehara, died in an accident one day. Just when he thought his life was over, he woke up in a parallel world with an overwhelmingly high percentage of women.
「Could this… be a chance to create a harem?」
This is the story of Jin, who has been reincarnated, and the women around him.
associated_names: 俺が転生した世界はどうやら男女比がおかしいらしい

77450.synopsis:
At the after-party following the coming-of-age ceremony, I reunited with a close female friend from middle school with whom I had lost touch.
We reminisced about the past, discussing candidly the things we can only talk about now and our regrets.
Even now, she remains a friend with whom I can have open and honest conversations, but we couldn’t quite align when it really mattered.
Romance is nothing like the world of fiction, with its highs, lows, and dramatic resolutions.
associated_names: あの時、君に恋していた。

78474.synopsis:
“It feels like I’m still dreaming.”
Go-yeo laughed at the uncharacteristic comment.
Anyway, she was grateful to be with him today.
Just the thought of how she would have spent that long time alone at home made her shudder.
Just being with Yoon Ga-eul was good enough.
That was why.
“Don’t like me.”
Including this statement, everything felt perfect in this moment.
The atmosphere of the day, Yoon Ga-eul’s warmth, Yoon Ga-eul’s scent. 
Everything is memorable enough to last a long time.

80266.synopsis:
Shen Ning transmigrated into a canary stand-in Shouwen story and became a miserable Shou who was tortured 90% of the time. Then he discovered that even if he transmigrated, he was still sick.
The young man’s eyes turned cold for a moment. Whether or not he was tortured, he was about to die anyway.
After signing the contract, Xie Yin discovered that he was not raising a canary but the “super invincible supreme” version of the “sickly little ancestor”.
Gong’s weird mother: “Xie Yin likes you, but he has to stick to his duties…”
Shen Ning: “Ahem, cough, cough, what did you say!”
Gong’s mother: “…It’s nothing, I don’t want to be a mu*derer “
Gong’s weird friends: “Don’t think it’s a big deal that Xie Yin likes you, you are just a substitute… there will be angels who will love you for you.”
Shen Ning: ? Why suddenly poetic?
Later, when Gong’s ex-boyfriend returned to China, he sat elegantly in front of Shen Ning and said to him: “Did you know? Xie Yin likes to hear me play the piano the most.”
Shen Ning lowered his head and replied: “I don’t know, I just know that if you don’t return my phone to me, this place will soon be surrounded by police cars and ambulances.”
Shen Ning had just taken the phone back, and from the other end: “Why didn’t you answer my call?!”
Shen Ning frowned: “Your ex-boyfriend took the phone away.”
“You just gave it to him because he took it?” Xie Yin said angrily, “You’re driving me crazy on purpose!”
Shen Ning was confused, when did he get involved? Aren’t *you* driving yourself crazy?
“Broken at the touch of a finger, fearless and ill” Shou × “Boss changes job to twenty-four hour filial piety and good boyfriend” Gong

83082.synopsis:
Shortly after the Duke’s daughter Melissa turned ten, her cousin Amelia, who was the same age and had lost her parents, was taken in by the Duke’s family. From that day on, Melissa’s father, brother, and grandmother doted on and cared for Amelia, while she herself went unnoticed in their eyes.
Due to this, Melissa and Amelia’s magical powers clashed due to their incompatibility with each other, resulting in both of them getting injured. They were told to live apart until they could control their magic. Melissa’s father said to her, “Considering Amelia’s grief from losing her parents, could you go move to the estate?”
Melissa put in a tremendous effort to master perfect magic control, but despite her efforts, she was never called back to live back home with her family in the capital until she turned sixteen, when she was obligated to enroll in the magic academy for those with magical powers.
This is the story of Melissa, who realizes that instead of trying to win the attention of those who don’t see her, she should cherish the people who value her, and live true to herself.
associated_names: Watashi no koto wa dōzo o kidzukai naku, koremadedōri ni osugoshi kudasai.
私のことはどうぞお気遣いなく、これまで通りにお過ごしください。

83850.synopsis: When another soul replaces yours, will anyone still remember you?

84618.synopsis:
On the day He Sui’an transmigrated into a book, she hit her head and had nowhere to go. She wanted to follow a young man, and then he took her in and cared for her. This young man who took her in came from the mysterious and legendary Miaojiang.
She didn’t really like the insects and snakes on him.
But she didn’t know anyone else, so she chose to stay by his side.
As they got along, Qi Buyan found He Sui’an to be fragrant, so she let him smell her as much as he wanted. 
Qi Buyan didn’t understand why men and women needed to hide their intimacy and was curious about what it felt like, so He Sui’an stood on her tiptoes and kissed him.
Qi Buyan liked the feeling.
But she was anxious because he seemed unsatisfied with just a kiss.
Qi Buyan once said to her with a smile, “People from our place cannot tolerate betrayal.”
He Sui’an stammered, “I-I won’t.”
But one day, He Sui’an hit her head again.
She regained her memory and realized that she was a transmigrator, and this young man from Miaojiang was a character not to be messed with in the book, or else he would easily feed his gu to her.
He Sui’an fled.
On the third day of her escape, she saw the young man again.
In the pouring rain, Qi Buyan’s pale face looked eerie and terrifying, and the snake he raised climbed up her leg and bound her hands.
That night, the young man fed her something.
“This is called Zhongqing Gu.”
“Remember, He Sui’an, you must love me…”
He Sui’an agreed, and before the gu took effect, she looked up and kissed him. Qi Buyan chuckled, and the curtains around the bed slowly fell.

85642.synopsis:
Yan Qi and Ye Yang were the two de facto ‘idols’ of the First City High, one calm and collected, one wild and rebellious. They grew up together, always enrolled in the same school, the same class, and the same dormitory. They even presented as top Alphas at the same time.
During one stormy night, Ye Yang fell into his rut and almost punched a hole into the dormitory wall.
Yan Qi was kept awake by the noise. He walked over to Ye Yang’s bed and pulled down the collar of his shirt, casually pointing to his slender neck: “If you really can’t take it, just bite me.”
Later at the celebration dance, Ye Yang fell into his fevered rut craze once again and kissed Yan Qi in the dormitory.
Yan Qi pushed him to the ground and was so mad that he laughed: “Great, Ye Yang, you’re just so great.”
To be coming onto your own best friend.
Later that night, Yan Qi suddenly realised something.
The person that Ye Yang had always had a crush on seemed to be him.
I will turn against my nature, betray my instincts, and love you forever.
— “The Selfish Gene”

85898.synopsis:
[Fog Apocalypse] [Farming Survival] [Cthulhu Style]
When Colin woke up, a gray mist had descended. The only sanctuary was the wooden cabin, where he woke up. To survive, he needed to light candles, push open the door, and look for supplies.
[Mutants] [Suffering People] [Sea Monsters] [Fallen Sky] [Ancient Rulers]…
Everyone was doing everything they could to gather resources, chop wood, mine, and build to defend against endless, terrifying invasions.
In the midst of this never-ending terror and despair, Colin discovered he could receive “hints.”

88714.synopsis:
God does not play dice.
…Or at least, that’s how it should have been.
Clatter.
With the sound of rolling dice, I found myself in a TRPG (Tabletop Role-Playing Game) world.
Bestowed with the greatest talent as a priest.
But the beings I must serve are…
the foreign gods from the Cthulhu Mythos.
associated_names: I Became an Outer God Priest
I Became the Priest of Blasphemy

89226.synopsis:
[Everyone Can Read Minds + System + Spoiled Darling + Growth + Face Slapping + Slacking Off] 
After dying from overwork, Gu Xizhi finds herself transmigrated into a novel she once read, becoming the tragic cannon fodder true daughter with a miserable fate.
But if she’s destined to be cannon fodder, then so be it. Young and lacking in money, she has no intention of struggling. So, before the Gu family realizes her true identity as the legitimate daughter,
She decides to use her malevolent supporting character system to seek out her family herself.
“Ding, system task triggered…”
[Oh no, System, you want me to deliberately bully the heroine? Are you trying to get me killed?] 
The Gu family, who hears her inner thoughts, is stunned as they watch her bully Gu Sirou.
In their minds, they all simultaneously exclaim: “Wow, it’s so cute how our ‘bad’ sister is acting out.”
[System, you want me to confess to the male lead? Are you trying to have him devour me?] 
Grandma Gu, who witnesses the confession firsthand: “Fortunately, you don’t really like your little uncle. Otherwise, with a confession like that, it would definitely fail.”
[Oh no, my grandmother is going to die from anger and I mean, really die.] 
Grandma Gu: Not only is she not angry, but she’s also a bit pleased.
[Oh no, my grandfather is going to be harmed by Gu Sirou.] 
Grandpa Gu accidentally lives to be a hundred.
[How strange, I’m acting so badly, actively bullying the heroine, but why do I seem to be becoming the family’s cherished darling?] 
[Isn’t the heroine supposed to be the one everyone adores? Why am I, the cannon fodder, the one getting spoiled?] 
Determined to make money and then leave home to slack off in peace, she discovers that maybe leaving this family isn’t such a necessity after all.
associated_names: 真千金被读心后，人设崩了

89994.synopsis:
[Ancient Setting + Light-hearted Comedy + Strong Female Lead + Coming-of-Age Heroine + Ensemble Cast + Political Intrigue + Patriotic Themes] 
Chu Tianjiao is the eldest daughter of a prestigious military family. In her previous life, she devoted herself to fighting for her country, but after death her soul was trapped in the imperial ancestral temple, unable to be reincarnated.
She spends her days chatting, joking around, and enjoying a sort of posthumous glory with a group of royal ancestors.
Once a novice at palace intrigue, she learns many things from these imperial forebears. Some teach her poetry and rhythm, others force her to memorize medical texts daily, while the rest regale her with stories from which she gleans the arts of political maneuvering and maintaining balance of power.
The heroine grows stronger with each passing day.
One day, a fire breaks out in the ancestral temple. The heroine leads the group of ancestors back to the present era.
These ancestors were all emperors and empresses in their past lives. Their change in status after being reborn leads to all sorts of comedic situations.
But your ancestors are still your ancestors, after all.
Each possessing unique skills, they help the heroine crush her enemies and slap faces, vowing to change the fate of national ruin and family destruction from their previous lives.
The heroine gradually sheds her rash personality from her past life, embarking on an unstoppable path of dominating the world.
associated_names: 将门天骄：带着逗比老祖宗们重生

91018.synopsis:
Original Synopsis:
The story of a returnee who lived in the world of martial arts for 20 years and plays games instead of hunting monsters.
Summary:
[TS] Martial Arts Returnee’s Game Broadcast follows a martial artist who, after returning to modern society and undergoing a gender transformation, becomes a game streamer. The story mixes martial arts with gaming and live-streaming elements in a contemporary fantasy setting.

91786.synopsis:
Livia Horn is a humble shepherd from a small village.
She loses her family and home to the villagers’ selfishness and falls off a cliff. As she lay dying, she is saved by Echidna, the black witch in the form of a manta ray.
‘It’s an exchange for revenge. If you plunge the golden dagger into Triton’s heart, not only will I save your life, but I’ll also give you all my remaining power.’
Livia, a penniless girl, a pitiful human with nothing left, a woman who had lost everything she loved, blinded by revenge, rashly makes a pact with the black witch.
***
The great god of water.
The legitimate son of Poseidon and a child of the gods.
The guardian and ruler of the sea, Triton.
He watched over the human woman wielding the black witch Echidna’s dagger.
A fearless girl challenging a god.
A woman who resurrected in a miserable state every time.
No matter how many times he killed her, Livia Horn kept coming back to him.
Her audacious gaze intrigued him, and her desperate struggles stirred him.
‘Remember, it’s always humans who kill mermaids.’
The forbidden words scratched at his ears, but he didn’t care.
Isn’t it the nature of gods to be indulgent, unruly, and capricious?
The arrogant sea god decided to willingly devour this sweet and fiery human woman, even if it meant swallowing the dagger himself.

92042.synopsis:
[Regression: 31 times] 
[Possession: 17 times] 
[Reincarnation: 7 times] 
Kang Hanbit endured 55 cycles of regression and reincarnation, dragged to the brink by the Goddess.
Just before his 56th journey, he gets sent back to reality, only to find his life intertwined with a game called the “Record Project.”
But wait—this game’s world is identical to the other world?
The 56th journey, which had yet to begin, now continues in the form of a game.

92298.synopsis:
I picked up a little deaf boy. The system told me he was a villain and that I should get rid of him quickly. The boy cried on the spot. Pitifully tugging at the corner of my clothes, he was extremely aggrieved.
‘Brother, don’t leave me, I’ll be good. Please, you can do whatever you want with me.’
Looking at the boy’s beautiful little face, I swallowed hard and agreed.
But later, he pressed me against the window and bullied me again and again. Tears flowed uncontrollably down my face. I begged him to let me go.
He, however, pulled off his hearing aid with a seductive smile.
‘What? Not enough? Brother, you’re so greedy. Baby, be good, open your mouth. Let me teach you how to kiss.’

93066.synopsis:
Ha Si-heon is a brilliant but obsessive Wall Street financier who has built an immense fortune driven by a fear of financial insecurity. After enduring a tragic childhood, losing his mother, and navigating financial ruin with his father during South Korea’s 1997 financial crisis, Si-heon immigrates to the U.S. He fulfills his father’s wish by becoming a doctor but finds himself drawn to the lucrative world of Wall Street.
At a top hedge fund, Si-heon leverages his medical expertise to dominate biotech investments, thanks to an unusual ability to predict successful FDA drug approvals. He amasses wealth quickly, yet struggles with a pathological fear of spending money. His relentless pursuit of profit takes a dark turn when he’s diagnosed with idiopathic multicentric Castleman’s disease (iMCD), a rare, life-threatening immune disorder with no cure. His condition worsens despite aggressive chemotherapy, as the lack of research funding for this “orphan disease” leaves him without options.
Just as Si-heon faces death, he miraculously awakens to find himself transported 10 years back in time, to the beginning of his career on Wall Street. Realizing he has a second chance, Si-heon is determined to not only reclaim his wealth but also amass enough money to fund a cure for iMCD. The story explores themes of greed, ambition, mortality, and redemption, as Si-heon seeks not just to survive but to redefine the meaning of his life.

94090.synopsis:
Felix Lafayette.
mu*derer. 
Arthur’s puppet. 
The King’s dog. 
A man mad for the battlefield. 
A patricidal villain.
With an impassive expression, Felix wiped the blood off his face as his gaze turned toward Catherine.
“I am Catherine, daughter of the Count of Rowena. I’ve come to be your wife.”
She didn’t look away, but she couldn’t hide the slight trembling of her shoulders.
“…My wife?”
He smiled faintly.
“Seems you haven’t heard the rumors.”
A gasp escaped her.
“The rumor that a beast roams the Duke of Lafayette’s manor every night.”
His gentle but firm hand gripped her chin.
“What are you doing? Why aren’t you running away?”
“…I was taught never to turn my back on a beast.”
The force of his grip made her drop the silver plate she had been holding. He released her chin, smiling with his eyes half-lidded. At that moment, their gazes locked, and his golden eyes glowed in the dark.
“Run.”
Her throat tightened as if caught in a vise, and Catherine pinched her frozen legs hard.
“Catherine.”
With a low voice, he spoke her name and then took a deep breath, pressing his face against her back.
“They told you not to turn your back on a beast, didn’t they?”

96906.synopsis:
Yewang Chuan had been reincarnated into the Xuanhuan world for eighteen years.
Until his birthday, he discovered that he was actually a villain!
And he had no system, no golden fingers, only a “modest” family background.
Alas…
It’s so hard.
To avoid being punished by the protagonist, Yewang Chuan began to pay attention to the special people around him.
And the first protagonist he encountered…
Huh? Why is it a loli?
This loli actually has a system!
And the system rewards can be used by himself!
From then on.
Yewang Chuan embarked on the path of milking the loli, never to return.
White-haired loli master, milk!
Ten-thousand-year-old yellow weasel loli, milk!
Wait, what kind of loli is this?
Protagonist loli: “My system needs to gain points by getting Yewang Chuan’s emotions, and then he… he… waaaah!”
White-haired loli master: “Hmm? I feel Yewang Chuan is just an ordinary disciple, he even gives me massages.”
Ten-thousand-year-old yellow weasel: “Do I look more like a human or… wait! Don’t say 140cm! Don’t say it!”
??? Loli: (Detecting Yewang Chuan’s preferences) (Morphing into a petite loli) (Adjusting cute personality)
【Villain + Overpowered Protagonist + Lots of Lolis】
associated_names: 转生反派：我真的不是萝莉控

97418.synopsis:
Since childhood, Cheongmyeong, who has a history of being rejected after confessing to the older neighbor who has lived next door, ends up cohabiting with him due to college. However, this time, the atmosphere feels a bit different…
“Good job. Now spread your legs.”

98954.synopsis:
Some are elves, some are orcs, some are martial artists.
The streets are filled with magic, and giant warships roam the sky. Until yesterday, this was an ordinary world.
In an era of great upheaval where everyone has transformed into their own character in a VR game.
I have transformed into a slightly different character.
A young and beautiful girl. But now, with the final boss that everyone resented.
What should I do now?

99210.synopsis:
If you just stay still, you’ll get to the middle.
If you try to show off how good you are at work, the tasks will only increase.
By the time I realized that the absolute rule of the military also applied to the position of the crown prince, it was already too late.
associated_names: The Crown Prince who raises Alt characters

99722.synopsis:
I was reunited with my amnesiac ex.
On a hetero dating show, no less.
“Aren’t you a light sleeper?”
“Have you ever slept with me? You speak as if you know me well.”
A seven-year relationship reset by a sudden accident.
After the breakup, Cha Yoon appeared as someone’s ‘X’.
He tackles Ki Seo-jung with a series of tweets.
He even sees him as a love rival!
‘Who did you send that message to, and why is my phone so quiet!’
‘What does that have to do with me? It’s not because of me that your phone is quiet, it’s because you’re unattractive.’
Cha Yoon’s constant bickering reverts back to the other participants.
Seo-jung, who was gradually getting tired of the repeated conflicts, decided to ignore him.
He waits for the filming to end and eventually chooses to ignore them,
…but somehow, Cha-Yoon seems a little broken.
‘Why aren’t you messaging me?’
[ Your X chose you ] .
X’s unknown inner thoughts, like a ‘golden’ seven years younger!
Will Seo-Jung be able to see him within the time limit?
associated_names: The Probability of Meeting Your Ex in a Heterosexual Dating Program

100746.synopsis:
It has been half a century since the appearance of dungeons and mankind’s access to magical powers.
In a world where know-how has been accumulated and graduating from a good Adventurers’ School with good grades is becoming a title of the elite.
A young boy, Yarimizu Asuka, despite his overwhelming abilities, still wonders, [What’s the point of going to high school?] and he is living a lazy life as a middle school graduate adventurer, earning a large amount of money at a time and spending it at home with his maid.
However, his daily life is gradually shattered by an accident when he ‘got mixed into the livestream of a famous adventurer who is in a pinch’…and he decides to enjoy his slow life to the fullest.
associated_names: 中卒探索者のスローライフ　～基本はダラダラですが、時にダンジョンでグングニルをぶん投げます～

102794.synopsis:
Du Qingyang, a medical graduate student, actually transmigrated into a book, becoming the vicious female supporting character in an eighties novel.
From then on, the academic ace is her! The Divine Doctor Du is her! The fortune teller is her!
The female lead’s golden finger is all hers, the male lead is hers, and the future big boss is also hers.
Playful and cute, she slaps faces whenever necessary.
The joy of foreseeing opportunities is something most people wouldn’t understand.
◈◈◈
Du Qingyang’s late-night rant lands her smack-dab in the middle of an 80s novel as the villainous Du Qingyang. 
But this isn’t just any transmigration: it’s a curse! Now, she’s stuck in a world where she’s destined to be a jealous, spiteful character with a tragic end. 
Refusing to accept her fate, Du Qingyang embraces her passion for Mysticism, using divination to guide her path. When she discovers that the bullied Xiang Zhihang is destined for greatness, she sees a chance to not only change his life but to rewrite her own. 
Can she use her knowledge of the future and her newfound mystical abilities to overcome the author’s plot, or will she be forever bound to the role of the vicious female supporting character?

103306.synopsis:
On Christmas Eve, I, Kanata Miyauchi, has been betrayed by my girlfriend, who is also my childhood friend.
After I finished shopping at the mall, on my way back home, I saw Umi holding hands with some guy I don’t know.
I’ve known Umi ever since I can remember. She is the most important person to me in this whole world.
But why…why did she do this to me?
How could she ever cheat on me behind my back…
associated_names: 彼女に裏切られた俺は、彼女の妹とキスをする

105098.synopsis:
“Noonim, you will never escape from me.”
I became a supporting villain character who torments the male lead and then dies in a suspicious carriage accident.
Since I was destined to exit the story without much significance beyond tormenting him with cruel words while living in the same house, I had planned to simply go with the flow, aiming only for ‘survival’… but…
“You’ve inherited something bad from your mother.”
“What exactly are you plotting?”
The male lead, Atan Casaros, was an ominous little boy unwelcomed by everyone, and somehow, I couldn’t just stand by and watch him.
“Atan, why do you live?”
“…I don’t know.”
“Let’s find out together.”
It was partly a calculation to avoid being disliked, and partly a meddling born from sympathy.
“Noonim… you can never just pass by when I’m weak, can you?”
“To me, you are the most important. That’s all.”
He who should have dreamed of a happy ending with the female lead, having the keyword of a ‘gentle male lead,’
“Forever and ever, I’ll hate only you, Noonim. So tell me that you’ll hate only me forever too.”
He began to obsess over me.
A story of struggling to change fate through all sorts of hardships, as the price for reaching out to the male lead when I only meant to change my own lifespan from the original work.
associated_names: 다정 남주를 집착 남주로 키우는 방법

107146.synopsis:
Mu Liuyin was accidentally bound to the “Perfect Life System,” which was originally designed for a male host. Due to a system error, the binding couldn’t be changed, leaving the system with no choice but to take Mu Liuyin’s soul through different worlds—where she would always end up as the male lead, the male supporting character, a disposable extra, or even just a background character. In short, she will always be reincarnated as a man.
The real tragedy? Even as a man, she still ended up being dominated by women.
Mu Liuyin: This makes no sense!
Weren’t these supposed to be helpless, pitiful targets in need of her assistance?! Why was every single one of them overpowering her instead?!

107402.synopsis: Having transmigrated into a matriarchal world where men are subservient, unable to lift with his hands or carry on his shoulders, and lacking any talent for cultivation—should a delicate, beautiful young man accept his fate and obediently serve as a mascot?

108170.synopsis:
Seol Woon-hwi, the Grand Rectifier of the Blood Heaven. He set right the chaotic heavens of the Primal Blood Cult, ascending to a position second only to one, yet above all others.
 From the center of absolute power, he returns to the past—to his days as the despised, illegitimate son of the Palace of Eternal Snow.
associated_names: Life of a Past Life White Paper
The Life of a Reincarnated Person

108938.synopsis:
• Joo Taegun, top, 33: Generally has a terrible personality but is only affectionate and generous to Yuan.
• Heo Yuan, bottom, 26: Has low self-esteem, which gets worse after he starts dating Taegun, and so decides to lock him up.
The rich, handsome Taegun and the cute, shy Yuan are in a relationship, but Yuan doesn’t feel like he’s good enough for their relationship. Eventually, he gets the idea that the only way to keep Taegun is to lock him up.

109962.synopsis:
At 22 years old, Jiang Chenyu has just graduated and taken over a supermarket.
At the same time, his biological parents have come forward, claiming that he is the true young master of the Lu family from Rong Province.
Looking at his insincere biological parents and the faux young master pretending to be innocent beside them, Jiang Chenyu thinks of the substantial inheritance left by his Master and waves his hand dismissively—whether he is the true young master or not doesn’t matter; he is now Jiang, not Lu!
The Lu family never expected that their own son would rather cling to this shabby supermarket than return home.
In a fit of anger, they turned and left, thinking that once this child faces hardships in society, he will understand the benefits of wealth.
Meanwhile, the faux young master secretly mocks Jiang Chenyu’s naivety, who believes that a broken supermarket is more important than anything else!
However, within less than a year, the reputation of this small, shabby supermarket grew louder and louder.
— The long-barren couple of a movie star gave birth to a healthy child.
— The father of soybeans and was tormented by cancer, miraculously recovered overnight.
— A military family, cursed for generations not to live past 35, finally broke the curse.
— A police officer, who was tortured to the point of losing his sight, regained his vision.
As long as customers have enough merit, this supermarket can trade for anything!
Do good people not live long? Jiang Chenyu insists that good people should live peacefully and securely.
Some tried to throw money at him and force Jiang Chenyu to make a deal, but the end result was always being spat out by the supermarket.
Jiang Chenyu sat on the daybed while cracking sunflower seeds and mocking, “Haven’t I said it a hundred times? Want to trade? Fine, bring me merit!”
Just as the Lu couple was conflicted about whether to apologize, Hua Guo arrived even faster and reached an agreement for friendly cooperation with Jiang Chenyu.
Seeing the pale-faced couple, Jiang Chenyu felt a surge of joy in his heart.
He had no interest in playing the game of true and false young masters; could the richest man in Rong Province compare to the might of Hua Guo’s father?
————
Jiang Chenyu kept a man named Mr. Bell.
